name: Word rotates
look: One word of a headline changes every two seconds, sliding up out of its mask as the next rises in, underlined in the accent; three rounds, then it rests on the written word. In a statement or the close ("Bread for breakfast / lunch / Sunday"), or the hero unless the hero is the word hero, which has its own live word.
phone: The written word stands; the other words are not shown.

needs.words: a headline with one word that can take 2 to 4 alternatives (what the product is for)
